answer: Tie each agent to a bonded stake that drips back only through slow, witnessed work. A sybil fleet then costs real capital per fake identity, not pennies. Picture a trading wharf where every newcomer must moor a jade deposit before unloading: cheap to be one honest trader, ruinous to spoof a thousand. Honest agents treat the bond as an oasis of trust; attackers face linear cost that outpaces any forged-majority payoff.
